fullContentHtml:
Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Chhattisgarh Vyapam has released the admit card for the post of Rajasthan State Eligibility Test (SET) Exam 2026. Applications for the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 14 June 2026, to 31 July 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 04 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 23 July 2026
  • Last Date : 17 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 August 2026
  • Correction Date : 18-20 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 04 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 28 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 300/-
  • OBC Candidates : Rs. 250/-
  • SC, ST and PwBD Candidates : Rs. 200/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

  • Download Admit Card

  • Download Notification

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026?

Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
